preferred_output.title: Find the Movement
preferred_output.instruction: Step outside and notice three things around you that are moving.
preferred_output.secondaryInstruction: Let your attention stay with each one for a few seconds.

preferred_output.title: Open a Window
preferred_output.instruction: Open a window and stand near it for a few minutes.
preferred_output.secondaryInstruction: Notice what the air brings in.

preferred_output.title: Under Open Sky
preferred_output.instruction: Sit or stand somewhere you can see open sky.
preferred_output.secondaryInstruction: Watch it for a while without trying to do anything.

preferred_output.title: Near the Light
preferred_output.instruction: Sit near the softest light you have.
preferred_output.secondaryInstruction: Let your eyes rest on something far away.

preferred_output.title: A Slow Five
preferred_output.instruction: Take a slow five-minute walk somewhere familiar and safe.
preferred_output.secondaryInstruction: Notice each foot touching the ground.
